text:
maria: Quick sync - formal pen-test kickoff in two weeks. Need an ops runcard for RBAC adjustments, KMS access window, and immutable audit export. Who can own ops for evidence handoff?

nate: I can. Need list of services that get ephemeral assume-role vs read-only creds.

elaine: +1. For readroom access prefer ephemeral STS role scoped to kms:Decrypt and logs:Read only. No key material.

alex: Vendor only verifies artifacts; envelope decrypt is enough. Don't grant kms:DescribeKey or key rotation perms.

maria: Draft policy below for review. Intend 6h max duration, require MFA on assume-role.

maria: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["logs:GetLogEvents", "logs:DescribeLogGroups"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

nate: Good start. Add explicit condition for aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent on sts:AssumeRole. Also log sts:AssumeRole events to the audit pipeline.

elaine: How do we make audit exports tamper-evident for the vendor window? Plan: export CloudTrail to a dedicated Object Lock S3 bucket and snapshot the bucket manifest.

alex: Yep. Create bucket with Object Lock & governance mode, enable CloudTrail multi-region export for the window, and forward a copy to SIEM. That avoids a single point of failure.

maria: Action items and owners: 1) nate - ephemeral role + MFA enforce + test assume flow (48h). 2) elaine - provision CloudTrail export bucket with Object Lock and retention note (EOD Fri). 3) alex - SIEM forwarder config & validation (EOD Fri).

nate: I'll draft IAM policy and test in staging. Will run assume-role dry-run and post logs here. Ping me for vendor creds handshake test.

elaine: I'll provision bucket, set retention to 90d governance, and run a dry-run export Wed 10:00 PST. I'll attach lifecycle and retention details to the ticket.

alex: SIEM forwarder scheduled Wed 10:15 PST. I'll validate event parity and share the verifier runbook in this thread.

maria: Triage SLAs for findings: P0/P1 within 72h, P2 within 7 days, everything else triaged into backlog. Objections?

nate: Sounds reasonable. Propose retest scheduling: first retest slot 2 weeks after patching begins, reserve a contingency slot the following week.

elaine: Add regression smoke tests for storage, auth flows, and audit export ingestion. We'll run them as part of retest signoff.

alex: I'll create GitLab CI jobs for the smoke tests and wire them to the retest tracker. Will post job links when ready.

sre-bot: scheduled: dry-run CloudTrail export Wed 3532124000 (10:00 PST). Reminder 1h before.

maria: Communication: we'll create an ephemeral channel the day before, invite vendor@supplier.com, limit invites after onboarding, and pin access window & rollback playbook.

nate: I'll create the channel and seed pinned messages: access window, contacts, emergency rollback steps.

elaine: Request: disable KMS key rotation for the evidence capture day to avoid key id churn that confuses verification.

alex: Ops will place a rotation hold for that date and document it in the runbook.

maria: Great. I'll open the pen-test ticket with action items and owners, include retest cadence and smoke tests. We'll follow up here. :white_check_mark:
